ideas.title: Telltales: trim a tall sail whose flow is solved in 3D every frame
ideas.critique: This fixes what round 1 got wrong. A 3D flow stepped every frame, riding with the cart, with threads in the same field, means the lag in the trim is the flow's own re-attachment time and not a refresh timer. Nothing on the island has answered the player like this before. The danger is in step 1: if the AR-4 sail in 3D also loses the luff, the threads will just droop on a smooth curve and the skill goes with it. The 2.5 m chord at 2-3 steps a frame also has to really hold real time with Lumi and the friends on screen.

ideas.title: Lay the road under a rolling cart: grab the plank behind, drop it in front
ideas.nearest: A copper wire keeps its bends
ideas.critique: It is a frantic loop that is funny to fail. It builds on sandfield.jl and wheelsand.jl, which already exist, and it is straight on todo #755. It falls apart if the plank just snaps to the beak or the cart creeps at a speed set by a script. The bog only counts if the wheel's sinkage is what really stops the cart.

ideas.title: A handcar: two friends pump a see-saw lever and the crank turns the wheels
ideas.critique: Dead centres and a flywheel that carries the crank through them come out of the joints, and that part is real. A rhythm game for pumping a lever is still the predictable form of a timing game. The ponies' bodies have to really drive the lever by their weight, or it is a puppet on a crank. The big goal's cart is electric, so this is a side road off it.

ideas.title: Heave: the friends lean, brace and slip as they rock the cart out of its rut
ideas.nearest: Thin ice, a take that misses
ideas.critique: This is round 1's Heave again. What is new is that the push goes through feet that hold or slip by the foot law, and that is the weak spot round 1 named. Pushes that add up like a swing are still the strong core, and it is the big goal's final moment. It depends on a cart and a rut that are not built yet, and on lean poses that have to read as weight, not as tilted dolls.

ideas.title: The friends ride the cart down the dune and steer by leaning
ideas.nearest: A snowball that grows as it rolls, a take that misses
ideas.critique: Steering by the difference in sinkage that each wheel's load makes is a nice emergent mechanism, and S-shaped ruts that pull later runs in are worth seeing again. A coasting sledge ride is a familiar game, and the turn may be too weak to feel unless the sand's drag really differs that much. It is downhill play with a cart that has no power, so it adds little to the road toward the big goal.
